title: Master card: bus summing
comments: Virtual-earth summing amps for the chain buses, 22k || 100p feedback (unity per 22k bus resistor)
Bus nodes are hierarchical so returns, compressor and SC listen can sum into them
Outputs <bus>_SUM are inverted; PFL_ACT pulled up to +5 V here
Pinout docs/CHAIN.md; master card is the end of the audio chain
